patches.label: unsupported recovered chapter editing is explicit and cannot fall back
patches.before:
<script lang="ts">
	import { PUBLIC_SITE_NAME } from "$env/static/public";
	import { Constants, Utils } from "$lib";
	import API from "$lib/API";
	import ErrorComponent from "$lib/components/ErrorComponent.svelte";
	import * as Empty from "$lib/components/ui/empty";
	import { Spinner } from "$lib/components/ui/spinner";
	import UploadChapterEdit from "$lib/components/upload/UploadChapterEdit.svelte";
	import { Session } from "$lib/stores";
	import { StatusCodes } from "http-status-codes";
	import { onDestroy, onMount } from "svelte";

	const { data } = $props();
	let chapter = $derived(data.chapter);
	let user = $state<User>();
	let isMounted = $state(false);
	let error = $state<Constants.Error.Error>();

	let lookupGeneration = 0, lookupDisposed = false;
	onDestroy(() => { lookupDisposed = true; lookupGeneration++; user = undefined; });
	$effect(() => {
		const target = data.chapter?.id, actor = $Session?.identity.id, generation = ++lookupGeneration;
		user = undefined; error = undefined; isMounted = false;
		if (!target || !actor) return;
		void (async () => API.User.Get(actor))().then(res => {
			if (lookupDisposed || generation !== lookupGeneration || actor !== $Session?.identity.id || target !== data.chapter?.id) return;
			if (res?.status === StatusCodes.OK && res.body?.id === actor) { user = res.body; isMounted = true; }
			else throw res?.status === StatusCodes.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS ? Constants.Error.TooManyRequests : Constants.Error.Unknown;
		}).catch(cause => { if (!lookupDisposed && generation === lookupGeneration) error = cause instanceof Constants.Error.Error ? cause : Constants.Error.Unknown; });
	});


</script>

<svelte:head>
	<title>Edit: {Utils.chapterHeadline(chapter)} - {PUBLIC_SITE_NAME}</title>
</svelte:head>

{#if error}
	<ErrorComponent {error} />
{:else if isMounted && user}
	{#key data.chapter.id}
		<UploadChapterEdit bind:chapter manga={chapter.relationships.manga} {user} />
	{/key}
{:else}
	<Empty.Root>
		<Spinner class="size-10" />
	</Empty.Root>
{/if}
